description: The generators whose output an analyzer recognises as generated from a schema, one row each, read by the analyzers, which decode a generated file by the row it matches, and by the schema reader, which reads a plugin of the generation configuration by its row. A file matches the first row, in this document's order, whose language is the file's, whose header pattern matches a line of the file's leading comments, whose runtime_import, where the row names one, the file imports, whose version interval, where the row names one, holds the version the output states, and whose option set the output meets. major is the generator's major version the row covers. cell is what the output's declarations bind, as grammar/analysis/bindings.md states each: exact, every message, enum, enum value, field, service and operation binds by reference; rpc-only, services and operations bind exactly and the file declares no message, enum or field; rpc-types-fallback, services and operations bind exactly and the file's other declarations take the fallback of scope types; fallback, the file takes the fallback of scope all; serializer-only, the output binds nothing and lists serializer entry points; exposure-only, the output binds nothing and the plugin's presence in the generation configuration is the HTTP exposure cap; unsupported, a recognised plugin whose version or option set no other row covers, which binds nothing and makes the merge write a binding-unsupported note. roles names, per role, the generated declarations that stand for a schema declaration, the registration forms and the hand-written implementers. plugin_tokens are the names the proto.plugins setting admits beside the plugins of these rows, each standing for a plugin that writes a language the suite does not analyze. http_exposure_plugins are the plugins whose presence in the generation configuration exposes a service over HTTP.

generators.options: every API level: open, hybrid and opaque
generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-go\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

roles.consumer: message types, fields (a oneof member through its wrapper struct's field), getters, Has and Clear methods, oneof wrapper types and opaque <Msg>_<Field>_case constants, enum constants, extension variables

generators.options: output of major 1 outside the interval of protoc-gen-go-1, or stating no version
generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-go\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

generators.options: output before API v2, which imports no protoimpl
generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-go\. DO NOT EDIT\.$
^// Code generated by protoc-gen-gogo[a-z]*\. DO NOT EDIT\.$
^// Code generated by protoc-gen-go-grpc\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

roles.consumer: of each RPC, the <Svc>Client interface method; of the service, the <Svc>Client interface, New<Svc>Client, and the <Svc>Server interface outside registration forms
roles.implementer: every method of a hand-written type converted to <Svc>Server that implements one of its methods

generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-connect-go\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

roles.consumer: of each RPC, the <Svc>Client interface method; of the service, the <Svc>Client interface, New<Svc>Client, and the <Svc>Handler interface outside registration forms
roles.implementer: every method of a hand-written type converted to <Svc>Handler that implements one of its methods

roles.consumer: of each RPC, the <Svc>Client interface method; of the service, the <Svc>Client interface, New<Svc>Client, and the <Svc>Handler interface outside registration forms
roles.implementer: every method of a hand-written type converted to <Svc>Handler that implements one of its methods

generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-go-vtproto\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

roles.consumer: none; MarshalVT and SizeVT encode, UnmarshalVT writes, CloneVT passes its receiver through and EqualVT reads every field

generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-grpc-gateway\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

roles.implementer: every method of the argument Register<Svc>HandlerServer converts to <Svc>Server

generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-go-grpc\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

generators.options: output of major 1 above the interval of protoc-gen-go-grpc-1, or stating no version
generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-go-grpc\. DO NOT EDIT\.$
^// @generated by protoc-gen-es v2\.

roles.consumer: message types and each ...Schema const through its declared type's argument, properties, oneof constituents, enum members or as-const enum properties; of each RPC, the GenService method property; of the service, the GenService const

generators.options: output of major 2 outside the interval of protoc-gen-es-2
generators.header: ^// @generated by protoc-gen-es v2\.
^// @generated by protoc-gen-es v1\.

roles.consumer: as protoc-gen-es-2, through typeName and fields

generators.header: ^// @generated by protoc-gen-connect-es v1\.

roles.consumer: of each RPC, the methods member; of the service, the service const

generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-ts_proto\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

roles.consumer: interfaces, properties and oneof=unions constituents joined by field number, enum members; of each RPC, the client method and the service path; of the service, as ts-proto-2

generators.options: every other option set, in a file that writes a service path
generators.header: ^// Code generated by protoc-gen-ts_proto\. DO NOT EDIT\.$

roles.consumer: of each RPC, the client method, one reference whatever its overload count; of the service, the ...ServiceClient const and interface and the ...Service definition
